messages:
Noah Patel: heads up  noticed orientation is set up as a recurring series but the APAC-friendly replay slot isn't part of the series. is that intentional?
Ivy Chen: good catch. we run a separate APAC replay the following day to avoid live fatigue. i can add it as an explicit alternate event rather than a series exception.
Rohit Menon: my mobile calendar (iOS) shows the recurring event one hour earlier than on desktop  DST weirdness? any known fixes?
Sasha Ivanov: yes, iOS sometimes uses the device timezone setting if calendar app permissions are off. check Settings > Calendar > Time Zone Override and set to "On" to force your preferred tz.
Noah Patel: thanks. another thing: we have a couple contractors (external emails) who need the invite but aren't in the org calendar. how do we invite them without exposing internal notes?
Calendar Admin: invite contractors using the external guest copy of the event (Onboarding > Share > External Guest). it sends a limited invite with only agenda, zoom link, and slides. do not add them to the onboarding calendar subscription.
Ivy Chen: perfect. also can we get the orientation recordings retained longer for compliance/contractor onboarding? legal asked for 6 months for a specific cohort.
Onboarding Bot: Default retention is 60 days. For cohort-specific extended retention, open a ticket to onboarding@redwood.com with the event id and retention period; we can extend to 180 days for approved requests and copy legal.
Rohit Menon: great, filing the ticket now. last tiny item  could the event subject include "(recurring)" and the timezone label PT so external guests know what to expect?
Ivy Chen: done  updated subject to "Orientation (recurring)  09:00 PT / 21:30 IST (APAC replay next day)" and added short prereq checklist for contractors + link to the external slides folder.
Sasha Ivanov: thanks  re-sent invites to two contractors and confirmed mobile tz fix worked. all set. :thumbsup:
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: recurring series reminders set 48h and 15m. Recording upload pattern: ~30-90 minutes post-session. For extended retention, confirmation email will include S3 path and access controls.
